training.title: Training
briefing: Ten training rings are set up around the island. Fly through the glowing yellow rings in order.
Once you clear them all, two mock enemy fighters will appear above the island.
Shoot both down with your missiles and gun.
Stay inside the combat area (6 km from the island's center).

first-sortie.title: First Sortie
briefing: Unidentified fighters have entered our airspace from the north of the island. This is not a drill.
Two are inbound now, with one more close behind. Shoot down all three.
They carry missiles. When the warning sounds, use flares and break hard.

escort.title: Escort
briefing: A transport carrying evacuees will fly from the east coast to the west coast evacuation point.
Four enemy fighters will come after it in two waves.
The transport cannot evade. Drive off the attackers and get it to the west coast.
If the transport is shot down, the mission fails.

strike.title: Strike
briefing: We have located four enemy facilities on the island: a radar, a fuel tank, a hangar and an anti-air gun.
Destroy all of them. The AA gun in the west fires at anything within 2.5 km. When the "AAA" warning appears, turn to break its aim.
The hangar is tough, so use bombs or rockets. The fuel tank explodes; don't pass low right over it.

encounter.title: Encounter
briefing: We have detected two enemy fighters and a huge contact under the sea southeast of the island.
The contact is likely to surface while you are engaging the fighters. Its identity is unknown.
If a giant creature appears, concentrate your fire and drive it back into the sea.
Downing the fighters is optional, but watch your six.
